excluded_series.WCOILBRENTEU: Out-of-domain control for this labour-market slope-shift experiment; retain its existing FOCuS scale=None legacy evidence only.

analysis.historical_matching: Use registered event signs; one-to-one maximum-cardinality/minimum-absolute-lag matching within the existing contract's +/-12 calendar-month window. Historical matching is diagnostic only and cannot select thresholds or parameters.
analysis.payems_input: The contract-registered first difference of first-release PAYEMS levels; the new detector compares local changes in that monthly change series (local acceleration).
analysis.series_parameterization: Cadence/representation-based and frozen before execution: weekly ICSA uses a 6-observation local window; monthly UNRATE and causally first-differenced PAYEMS use 12 observations. The same detector equations, confirmation rule, scale estimator, threshold grid, and risk gates apply to all three series.
analysis.time_order: Sort by observation_date and available_at as defined by the frozen intake contract; require non-decreasing available_at. Every reported detection index maps to the right-edge row's available_at.

decision_policy.production_promotion: No automatic promotion from this experiment. A detector is risk-validated only per-series when Development and independent Holdout gates both pass. Historical matching remains diagnostic and does not make a detector production-ready.

Causal Local Slope-Shift.method: Use the same 40-observation initial calibration prefix as C3; no alert may occur before observation 40. Then compare the median of the latest window of first differences with the median of the immediately preceding window. Normalize their difference by robust baseline scale times sqrt(pi/window). Require three consecutive same-sign threshold crossings. Re-arm only after six consecutive scores fall below 0.5 times the frozen threshold.
Causal Local Slope-Shift.scale_policy: Baseline-window MAD sigma; if degenerate use baseline IQR sigma; if both degenerate use the median nonzero absolute deviation within that same baseline window (quantization fallback, including a single nonzero deviation). If the complete local baseline is still degenerate, abstain from scoring that point. Never borrow expanding history or include current-window values in scale.

Post-Quiet Huber + Bartlett LRV.method: Existing C3 v2.2 post-quiet Huber detector with Bartlett LRV scale; no source or implementation changes.

Post-Quiet Huber + MAD.method: Existing C3 v2.2 post-quiet Huber detector with MAD scale; no source or implementation changes.

focus_disposition.policy: Do not run scale=40 or use FOCuS as a labour-series candidate in this phase. Retain FOCuS legacy scale=None as the WCOILBRENTEU-only reference disposition from the completed ablation. UNRATE remains excluded from FOCuS adoption.
focus_disposition.pr_70: Keep open Draft; no merge or close.

null_protocol.lookahead_policy: No future observations in AR fitting, score windows, scale estimation, threshold calibration, re-arm, or event detection. Every historical alert must reproduce on a prefix ending at its own detection index.
null_protocol.null_generator: Stable AR(p) residual bootstrap using p=1..3 selected by minimum AIC on the first 40 first-release analysis observations only; bootstrap horizon equals the original series length.
null_protocol.paired_comparison: Generate each Development/Holdout null trace once per series and score all three detectors against that identical trace. No detector-specific resampling.
null_protocol.phase_separation: Development and Holdout use distinct phase labels in the seed identity; Holdout seeds are disjoint from Development and all prior C3 V2/V2.2 namespaces.
null_protocol.seed_identity: SHA256(namespace, normalized_tape_sha256, series_id, selected_AR_order, phase, replicate_index), first 64 bits as integer

purpose: Calibrate and compare a causal local slope-shift detector against Post-Quiet Huber + MAD and Post-Quiet Huber + Bartlett LRV on the frozen C3 v2.2 first-release source intake.

risk_gates.holdout_without_development_threshold: Do not score or inspect Holdout outcomes for threshold selection; record NOT_RUN_NO_DEVELOPMENT_THRESHOLD. The 2000 Holdout traces remain generated and their valid count is recorded.
risk_gates.threshold_selection: For each detector and series independently, select the lowest pre-registered threshold whose Development Wilson U95 is <=0.085. Evaluate that one frozen threshold once on the independent Holdout. Never retune from Holdout.

source.source_policy: Reuse the exact existing source-intake artifact; do not acquire fresh ALFRED/FRED data. Validate every raw vintage batch hash and the normalized first-release tape hash before execution. PAYEMS transformation uses the already archived predecessor batch and preserves the current observation available_at.
